source: CHS Arctic hydrographic contract to Sedna ROV Services (Iqaluit), C$6.5M over two seasons, 9,000+ line-km in the first (DFO, March 2024): ~C$720 per line-km; at a 350 m swath with 20% overlap, ~C$2,600 per km²
amundsen_context: CCGS Amundsen 2021: ~38,700 km² mapped over an ~80-day season (Copernicus ESSD 2024), i.e. several hundred km²/day in transit mapping of deep water; 40 km²/day is conservative for 100–130 m shelf water
srtm15_release: SRTM15+ V2.7 released 21 April 2025 (Scripps); inherits the cumulative NCEI multibeam archive of earlier point releases
